01

Explore the hand-object manifold

The default representation is link_near_and_distance_joint. It combines joints, palm-object relations, object shape, 5 mm proximity indicators for 26 hand links, and size-normalized distances. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, and color points by source, cluster or object. Select a point or star to inspect its representative and available videos. Cluster numbers are specific to each representation.

Each point describes one interaction configuration from 6,241 HOI references. PCA axes are scaled separately by their standard deviations for visualization; raw coordinates remain available in the point details. Proximity in this 3D view does not establish proximity in the full feature space. The E1 pose analysis below uses a separate population.

02

Six clusters, observed representatives

Each representative is an observed sample nearest its cluster center. Compare its hand pose with a recorded teacher interaction from the same final cluster; these are different frames and references. The C4 representative has no link within 5 mm of the object, so these groups should not all be interpreted as stable grasp types.

03

Recorded teacher interactions

One example per final cluster, using General teacher model_5200.pt. The wrist follows its reference while the teacher controls the fingers. These color recordings are matched by complete reference identity and trimmed to the original display durations. Their original rollout measurements remain linked separately.

Stable tail HOLD: in at least 95% of the final 30 simulation ticks, the object is lifted ≥2 cm and at least two target-contacting fingertips reach 0.5 N. These are selected examples, not an aggregate success rate or a five-second HOLD evaluation.

04

PCA: variance and reconstruction

E1 indexes 1,029,112 poses, of which 1,015,044 satisfy URDF limits. A trajectory-key split and source-balanced sampling produce 8,867 fitting poses and 5,016 test poses. Sharpa uses 22 joint angles; the human analysis uses 60D hand-local landmarks normalized by hand length. These feature spaces are analyzed separately.

PCA-14 retains 96.1% of variance, yet fingertip FK reconstruction error after clipping still averages 10.1 mm, with a P95 of 26.7 mm. High variance retention does not guarantee precise contact geometry.

05

Pose banks: coverage and transfer

All exported bank entries are observed poses within joint limits. KMeans centers are replaced by their nearest training samples; approximate K-Medoids alternates over a candidate pool. Coverage is the mean of source-wise median nearest-pose errors, in radians. Diversity uses pairwise L2 distances after joint-range normalization.

Kinematic validity and population limits

Only about 10–25% of sampled poses in some SPIDER source subsets pass the current URDF limit check; the cause remains unresolved. Exported bank entries have zero joint-limit violations, but their PhysX self-collision pass rate has not been established.
